The workflows are on `action_required` (fork gate) — could a maintainer press "Approve and run workflows"? Local verification on the current HEAD (up to date with `master`):

- `bundle exec rake spec` — full suite green (test-queue, all workers 0 failures)
- `bundle exec rake internal_investigation` — 126 files, no offenses
- `bundle exec rspec spec/rubocop/cop/performance/redundant_block_call_spec.rb` — green (and green under `PARSER_ENGINE=parser_prism`)

The two new "accepts" specs (shadow preceded by a statement, nested shadow) fail on `master`.
